# Vendor Partnership Program

## Overview

The ShadowOS Vendor Partnership Program enables hardware manufacturers and system integrators to offer pre-certified, optimized ShadowOS distributions tailored to their platforms. This program establishes a structured relationship between ShadowOS and vendor partners to deliver enterprise-grade security configurations directly to end users.

## Partnership Tiers

### Platinum Partners
- **Annual Commitment**: $50,000+
- **Benefits**:
  - Dedicated technical contact and support
  - Custom kernel parameter optimization
  - Priority bug fixes and security patches
  - Co-branded device certification program
  - Quarterly partnership reviews
  - Pre-release beta access (30 days early)
  - Logo placement on certified devices page
  - Joint marketing initiatives and press releases

- **Requirements**:
  - Minimum 1,000 device units shipped annually
  - ShadowOS pre-load on 50%+ of qualifying product lines
  - Quarterly device certification submissions
  - BIOS/UEFI security feature requirements (TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, DRTM)

### Gold Partners
- **Annual Commitment**: $25,000
- **Benefits**:
  - Dedicated vendor contact for technical questions
  - Standardized kernel parameter optimization
  - Regular security patch priority
  - Device certification program
  - Semi-annual partnership reviews
  - Early access to releases (14 days)
  - Logo on vendor support matrix

- **Requirements**:
  - Minimum 500 device units shipped annually
  - ShadowOS pre-load on 30%+ of qualifying product lines
  - Semi-annual device submissions
  - Standard BIOS/UEFI security requirements

### Silver Partners
- **One-time Fee**: $5,000
- **Benefits**:
  - Community support forum priority
  - Basic device certification
  - Annual partnership review
  - Logo on vendor acknowledgments page
  - Vendor configuration templates available

- **Requirements**:
  - Minimum 100 device units shipped annually
  - Documentation of compatible device models
  - Basic security configuration alignment

## Application Process

### Step 1: Initial Inquiry (Week 1)
- Submit vendor partnership application form at: https://shadowcypher.site/vendor-apply
- Provide:
  - Company name and registration details
  - Product categories (workstations, laptops, servers, etc.)
  - Current device portfolio and annual shipments
  - Target tier (Platinum, Gold, or Silver)
  - BIOS/UEFI security capabilities audit

### Step 2: Technical Assessment (Weeks 2-3)
- ShadowOS engineering review of hardware specifications
- Compatibility assessment with ShadowOS kernel and drivers
- BIOS/UEFI security feature validation
- Device testing requirements documentation

### Step 3: Partnership Agreement (Week 4)
- Legal review of partnership terms
- Service level agreement (SLA) review
- Support contact identification
- Escalation procedures documentation

### Step 4: Onboarding (Weeks 5-6)
- Dedicated vendor support channel setup
- Kernel parameter optimization delivery
- Device certification process briefing
- Pre-load image generation (if applicable)

### Step 5: Certification (Ongoing)
- Monthly device submissions for certification
- Security vulnerability response coordination
- Performance optimization reviews
- Partnership KPI tracking

## Timeline

| Phase | Duration | Deliverables |
|-------|----------|--------------|
| Inquiry Review | 5 business days | Initial assessment & requirements checklist |

## Certification Requirements

### Hardware Compatibility
- CPU: x86-64 (Intel/AMD) or ARM64
- Memory: Minimum 8GB RAM recommended
- Storage: NVMe or SSD preferred, HDD supported
- TPM 2.0: Required for Platinum/Gold, optional for Silver
- Secure Boot: Required for Platinum/Gold

### BIOS/UEFI Requirements
- UEFI mode boot support
- Secure Boot capability
- TPM 2.0 support (Platinum/Gold)
- UEFI Secure Boot key management
- Optional: Intel TXT or AMD SME for hardware virtualization

### Driver Support
- Network drivers (Ethernet, WiFi, Cellular)
- Graphics drivers (integrated and discrete)
- Audio subsystem drivers
- Touchpad/input device drivers
- Power management drivers
- BIOS update utilities

## Pre-load Program

### Pre-load Image Delivery
- Customized ShadowOS kernel with vendor-specific optimizations
- Pre-configured device drivers
- Vendor branding and identity customization
- Compliance certificates included
- Device attestation keys (if applicable)

### Manufacturing Integration
- ISO delivery format for bare-metal installation
- Secure image hash verification
- Delivery timeline coordination with manufacturing schedules
- Version management and update procedures

### Update Mechanism
- Signed update packages via ShadowOS servers
- Vendor-specific update channels
- Staged rollout support
- Rollback procedures documentation

## Device Lineup Management

### Certified Device Categories

**Workstations**
- Desktop computing platforms
- High-performance security workloads
- CAD/engineering applications
- Media production platforms

**Laptops/Mobile**
- Mobile security platforms
- Business laptops
- Secure field devices
- Travel-hardened systems

**Servers**
- Rack-mount systems
- Virtualization hosts
- Database servers
- Compliance/audit appliances

**Integrated Systems**
- Appliances with ShadowOS
- Kiosks/public computing
- IoT gateways
- Industry-specific platforms

### Certification Lifecycle
- **Active**: Currently certified and receiving updates
- **Maintained**: Legacy support, critical patches only
- **Deprecated**: End of vendor support, community support available
- **Retired**: No longer certified, archive only
